'''''Flueggea tinctoria''''' is a species of [[flowering plant|flowering]] [[shrub]] in the family [[Phyllanthaceae]], [[endemic]] to the [[Iberian Peninsula]].

==Description==
[[File:Flueggea tinctoria EnfoqueFlor 2012-4-01 SierraMadrona.jpg|thumb|left|Inflorescence and spines]]
''Flueggea tinctoria'' is a [[dioecious]], [[deciduous]] shrub with up to {{convert|2|m|abbr=on}} in height, very branchy from the base. Branches are erect-patent, spinescent, cylindrical, smooth or warty, glabrous or puberulous and have short, small and thick hairs. Leaves are alternate and [[Glabrousness (botany)|glabrous]]. Inflorescences have 2-4 (up to 6) fasciculate or solitary flowers, which are erect-patent in a male and sort of pendulous in the female; the [[Pedicel (botany)|pedicel]] of the male flowers is {{convert|2|-|6|mm|abbr=on}} and in the female {{convert|5|-|8|mm|abbr=on}}. It has 5 to 8 very exerted [[stamen]]s. Fruits are {{convert|3.5|-|4|mm|abbr=on}} in diameter, subglobose, depressed, trisulcate; pedicel is up to {{convert|15|mm|abbr=on}} long. Seeds are smooth, around {{convert|2|x|1.5|mm|abbr=on}} and convex on the back and flat laterally.<ref name="iberica">{{cite web |title=Flueggea tinctoria |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/08_108_01%20Flueggea.pdf |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=3 April 2021}}</ref>

==Distribution and habitat==
[[File:Flueggea tinctoria Habitus 2009-7-26 RioFresnedas ValledeAlcudia.jpg|thumb|left|Habit]]
''Flueggea tinctoria'' is native to the southwest quadrant of the [[Iberian Peninsula]] (inland [[Portugal]] and centralwestern-southwestern [[Spain]]), a good representative of the western [[Iberian sclerophyllous and semi-deciduous forests]]. It inhabits shrubby communities, on flood beds and torrential watercourses, on siliceous terrain, usually stony, from {{convert|20|to|200|m|abbr=on}} in altitude. It is especially dominant in the [[river basin]]s of the [[Guadalquivir]], [[Guadiana]], [[Tagus]] and [[Douro]].<ref name="iberica" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Flueggea tinctoria (L.) G.L.Webster |url=https://flora-on.pt/#/1Securinega+tinctoria |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=3 April 2021}}</ref>
